title: General TEA Tool — tea-schema.json
description: Machine-readable contract that Stage 0.1 (LLM compile) emits and every deterministic script reads. No script contains domain constants; they all dispatch off this config. See plan.md §4. This JSON Schema enforces STRUCTURE (types, enums, required core keys). Cross-reference and completeness checks (e.g. applies_to resolving to a real entity, an INTENSITY parameter declaring its numerator units) are layered on top by scripts/lib/schema.py, which surfaces them as hard errors or analyst-facing open questions rather than silent defaults.

execution_mode.description: Workflow interaction mode selected during setup. auto_with_human_gates pauses for analyst review; auto lets the AI resolve gates and requires a complete numeric final TEA. Omitted schemas default to auto_with_human_gates for backward compatibility.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract the config targets. Optional; defaults to "1.0".

tea_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this TEA instance (e.g. 'ti-6al-4v-incumbent').

vocabulary.description: Per-TEA display labels for the neutral code terms 'entity' and 'parameter' (D13). Code/config/CSVs always use the neutral terms; these labels are only for human-facing output.

functional_unit.description: The denominator everything is expressed per (drives INTENSITY normalization). e.g. 'kg billet', '1M tokens', 'delivery'.

basis.description: Currency/year/index/geography basis the whole TEA is normalized to.

currency.description: Base currency, ideally an ISO-4217 code (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR').

base_year.description: Year monetary values are escalated to.

inflation_index.description: Index used to escalate MONETARY values to base_year. 'none' disables escalation.

quality_tags.description: Ordered best-to-worst quality classes. Default A/B/C/D/E/U; E is a backed single-anchor estimate and U is an unbacked (loop 3) estimate (Phase 6). An analyst override re-tags E/U -> D.

entities.description: The list of entities (process units / cost centers / activities). Neutral term 'entity' (D13).

parameters.description: The parameter catalog. Reference values are parameters with context_free + reference_value (D8); they live under the reserved global entity 'REF', not per real entity.

estimation.description: Estimation policy + the comparable-similarity rubric (D9). comparable_rubric is required whenever any entity's estimation_policy is 'comparables_first' or 'either' (enforced by lib/schema.py).

conventions_needed.description: Declared (or derived) convention dependencies. Stage 0 derives these from the rule-types in use and scaffolds the matching conventions/*.csv. Tokens are free-form but conventionally one of: 'inflation_index:CEPCI|CPI|PPI', 'currency_rates', 'unit_conversions', 'scaling_exponents'.

validation_targets.description: Optional benchmarks the analyst may use for their own back-cast. The tool records them and surfaces them in the run manifest; it does NOT run the back-cast (D11).

defaults.description: Optional per-run caps/batch sizes. Absent values fall back to Vicky TEA defaults (master-list 15, gap-fill 5, extraction batch 8).

id.description: Stable entity identifier (e.g. '1A', 'compute_hardware'). Must not be the reserved global id 'REF'.

output.description: What the entity produces (e.g. 'TiCl4'). Required basis for parameters that normalize 'per entity_output'.

scope_frame.description: Per-entity relevance frame for the scope-relevance gate (D7). Generalizes Vicky TEA's incumbent-route.csv.

in_scope.description: Prose description of the in-scope configuration for this entity. Extracted values are checked against this.

known_out_of_scope.description: Named variants/routes that are explicitly out of scope (rejected on extraction).

rule_type.description: Normalization rule-type dispatched by normalize.py (D6, plan.md §5).

applies_to.description: Which entities this parameter applies to. 'all' (default) or an explicit list of entity ids. Ignored for reference_value parameters (those are global).

search_targetable.description: True if this parameter justifies a dedicated source search on its own (eligible for gap-fill targeting). Renamed from the legacy 'first_class' key.

context_free.description: True if this is a reference value searched WITHOUT TEA context (D8).

reference_value.description: True if this is a reference value (market constant) carried under the reserved global entity, not a per-entity cell.

scope.description: 'global' for reference values (one value for the whole TEA); 'entity' for per-entity cells (default).

units.description: Verbatim/declared units for the parameter where a single unit applies (e.g. RATE, some PASSTHROUGH).

numerator_units.description: Numerator units for INTENSITY parameters (e.g. 'kWh', 'kg'); the denominator is the functional unit (or entity output, per 'per').

per.description: INTENSITY denominator selector: the declared functional unit, or the producing entity's output.

canonical_unit.description: Canonical unit a (often reference) value is normalized to (e.g. 'USD/kWh').

basis.description: Free-form basis note (e.g. 'element-of-interest' for a FRACTION yield).

market_basis.description: For reference values: the market the price/figure is drawn from (e.g. 'US industrial bulk').

capex_form.description: For CAPEX parameters: the form the figure takes (e.g. 'total', 'specific_per_annual_output').

dimensions.description: The similarity dimensions the estimation scout scores (D9). Swapping these changes the scout's scoring fields.

hard_rule.description: The pass/fail rule applied to the rubric scores, in prose the scout enforces.
